blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates m ulti- v iew c aptions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation.
To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views.
We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/
blocks.zh:
通过扩大模型和数据集,视频文本预训取得了显著进展,但语言监督的质量仍然没有得到充分利用。 现有的网络尺度数据集往往每个视频只提供单一的零星字幕,无法捕捉丰富的spatiotal语义,同时直接使用字幕模型可以产生吵闹的描述. 我们提出一个大型多式联运大型语言模型监督生成框架,以改善监督的多样性、忠诚性和语义覆盖。 从1 000万个视频开始,我们的方法通过补充性摘要和详细标题、基于推理的改进和语义上的正标题生成m ulti-v iew c appitions(MVC)。
为了有效地利用不同颗粒体的监督,我们进一步引入了颗粒感知文字代表,并配有单独的CLS符号,供摘要和详细观察.
我们利用由此产生的监督手段,预先培训视频文本模型,并对这些模型进行跨标准、精细和详细的文本到视频检索基准的评估。 我们的方法在使用比现有方法更小的预训体型的同时,不断改进零射和微调的性能,显示了视频文本预训中丰富和互补的文字监督的重要性. 项目网页:https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video-text pretraining has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for learning transferable video representations ( Xu et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022b ; Bain et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023b ; Lei et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024c ; Doughty et al., 2024 ) . By aligning videos with natural language at scale, these approaches learn semantic representations that generalize across diverse downstream tasks, including retrieval, captioning, video question answering, etc. Inspired by the success of image-text pretraining ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2022b ) , recent efforts have scaled both video-text corpora and model capacity ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024c ; Chen et al., 2024c ) , establishing scaling as a dominant paradigm for advancing video-text learning.
blocks.zh: 视频文本预训已成为学习可转移视频表达的基本范例(徐等人,2021年;王等人,2022b); Bain等人,2021年;Wang等人,2023年;Li等人,2023年b;Lei等人,2023年b;Wang等人,2024年b;Wang等人,2024年c;Doughty等人,2024年b) 通过将视频与自然语言进行大规模对齐,这些方法学习了语义表达,将各种下游任务概括起来,包括检索,字幕,视频问答等. 在图像文本预训的成功激励下(Radford等人,2021年;Jia等人,2021年;Li等人,2021年;Li等人,2022年b),最近的努力既扩大了视频文本公司的能力,也扩大了模型能力(Wang等人,2024年b;Wang等人,2024年c;Chen等人,2024年c),确立了规模化作为推进视频文本学习的主导范式.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, most works primarily improve performance through larger datasets, stronger objectives, and increased model capacity, while the quality of language supervision itself remains comparatively underexplored. Existing video-text datasets are largely collected from web ( Bain et al., 2021 ; Miech et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) and rely on captions that are often short, sparse, weakly aligned, or noisy. As a result, rich video content is frequently compressed into a single high-level description that discards important visual cues. For example, a caption such as “a person playing football” captures the dominant activity while overlooking temporal progression, object interactions, and contextual details crucial for learning transferable representations. Since videos naturally contain multiple objects, actions, interactions, and evolving events, reducing them to a single description encourages models to learn coarse semantic correspondences while overlooking fine-grained dynamics and complementary relationships. This reveals a fundamental supervision bottleneck in current video-text pretraining: the limitation arises not only from insufficient information, but also from representing rich visual content through a single textual view. This naturally raises an important question: can rich video content be effectively learned from a single textual view? A video may admit multiple valid semantic interpretations, yet current supervision compresses these complementary signals into a single caption.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数工作主要通过更大的数据集,更强的目标,以及更高的模型能力来提高性能,而语言监督本身的质量仍然相对没有得到充分利用. 现有的视频文本数据集主要从网络上收集(Bain等人,2021年;Miech等人,2019年;Wang等人,2024年b),并依赖往往短,稀疏,弱的对齐,或吵闹的字幕. 因此,丰富的视频内容经常被压缩成单一的高级描述,丢弃重要的视觉提示. 例如,“一个人踢足球”这样的标题可以捕捉主导活动,同时俯瞰时间进展、物体相互作用和对学习可转移表述至关重要的背景细节。 由于视频自然包含多个对象,动作,互动,以及演化中的事件,将其简化为单一描述,鼓励模型学习粗糙的语义通信,同时俯瞰精细的动态和互补的关系. 这揭示了目前视频文本预训中的一个基本监督瓶颈:限制不仅来自信息不足,还来自通过单一文本视图代表丰富的视觉内容。 这自然提出了一个重要的问题:丰富的视频内容能否从单一的文本视图中有效学习? 视频可能允许多种有效的语义解释,但当前监管将这些互补信号压缩成单一标题.

blocks.en: A natural solution is to leverage multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate richer supervision automatically. Recent studies have demonstrated the potential of large-scale recaptioning pipelines ( Chen et al., 2024c ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . However, generating longer captions alone may not necessarily lead to better supervision, as such descriptions may emphasize irrelevant details, introduce incorrect information, or drift from the dominant visual content. Effective video-text supervision, therefore, requires signals that are not only richer, but also diverse , visually faithful , and semantically comprehensive .
blocks.zh: 一个自然的解决办法是利用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)自动产生更丰富的监督. 最近的研究表明,大型复航管道具有潜力(Chen等人,2024c;Zheng等人,2024c)。 2024; 陈等, 2024b; 陈等, 2024a). 然而,仅仅产生较长的标题不一定会导致更好的监督,因为这种说明可能强调不相关的细节,引入不正确的信息,或偏离主流视觉内容。 因此,有效的视频文本监督需要不仅更加丰富,而且多样化的信号,在视觉上是忠实的,而且非常全面。

blocks.en: In this work, we revisit video-text pretraining from the perspective of supervision quality and propose a fully automated MLLM-based framework for generating richer and more reliable textual supervision at scale. Given an input video, we generate summary and detailed descriptions using multiple instruction-tuned MLLMs, refine them through reasoning-based visual verification, and construct additional semantic positive captions capturing complementary perspectives. To effectively exploit supervision at different levels of granularity, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views, allowing them to be independently aligned with the video while learning complementary representations. Using this framework, we re-caption approximately 10 million videos to construct a large-scale video-text pretraining corpus. Extensive experiments across standard, fine-grained, and detailed video-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that m ulti- v iew c aptions (MVC) substantially improve video-text pretraining and provide a data-efficient alternative to simply scaling the number of video-text pairs.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们从监督质量的角度重新审视视频文本的预训,并提出一个完全自动化的基于MLLM的框架,以产生规模上更丰富和更可靠的文本监督. 鉴于一个输入视频,我们使用多种指令调制的MLLMs生成摘要和详细描述,通过基于推理的视觉验证加以改进,并构建附加语义正标题,捕捉互补视角. 为了有效地利用不同层次的颗粒性监督,我们进一步引入了颗粒感知文字代表,并配有单独的CLS符号,用于摘要和详细视图,允许它们与视频独立对齐,同时学习互补的表示. 利用这个框架,我们重新收集了大约1 000万个视频,以构建一个大规模视频文本预培训程序。 跨越标准、精细和详细的视频文本检索基准的广泛实验表明,m ulti-v iew c appitions(MVC)大大改进了视频文本的预训,并提供了一个数据效率高的替代方案,仅能缩小视频文本对数。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video-text pretraining has evolved from early approaches that learn aligned video-text representations through contrastive learning and cross-modal matching objectives ( Bain et al., 2021 ; Lei et al., 2021 ; Xu et al., 2021 ) . Building on these, subsequent works improved representation quality through larger-scale video-text datasets ( Lei et al., 2023 ) , stronger visual encoders and multimodal architectures ( Wang et al., 2022a ; Wang et al., 2022b ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023b ) , scaling strategies ( Wang et al., 2024c ) , and more effective masking ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . These developments have substantially advanced transfer performance across retrieval and video understanding tasks.
blocks.zh: 视频文本预训是从早期通过对比性学习和跨模式匹配目标学习对齐视频文本表述的方法演变而来的(Bain等人,2021年;Lei等人,2021年;徐等人,2021年). 在此基础上,随后的工程通过更大的视频文本数据集(Lei等人,2023年),更强大的视觉编码器和多式联运架构(Wang等人,2022a年); Wang等人,2022b;Liu等人,2022b;Li等人,2023b),缩放策略(Wang等人,2024c),以及更有效的面具(Zhuang等人,2026;Wu等人,2025). 这些事态发展大大促进了跨检索和视频理解任务的传输工作。

blocks.en: More recent efforts have further shifted toward large-scale video-text foundation models trained on millions or even billions of video-text pairs ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024c ; Wang et al., 2024c ) . While these approaches largely improve performance through model and data scaling, relatively few works investigate the role of supervision design itself. Our work differs from existing approaches by focusing on the supervision source and exploring whether richer, multi-view textual supervision can provide stronger learning signals for video-text pretraining.
blocks.zh: 最近的努力已进一步转向大规模视频文本基础模型,培训了数百万甚至数十亿对视频文本(Wang等人,2024b); Chen等人,2024c;Wang等人,2024c). 虽然这些方法通过模型和数据规模大大改进了业绩,但调查监督设计本身作用的作品相对较少。 我们的工作与现有方法不同,侧重于监督来源,并探讨更丰富、多视图的文字监督能否为视频文本预训提供更强的学习信号。

blocks.en: Several works have explored synthetic supervision to improve language quality by generating or rewriting captions using generative models and large language models, aiming to reduce noisy supervision and create more informative and grounded textual descriptions ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Islam et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 若干作品探索了通过使用基因模型和大语言模型生成或改写标题来提高语言质量的合成监督,目的是减少噪音监督,并创造更翔实和有依据的文字描述(Wang等人,2024b;Yuan等人,2025;Islam等人,2024;Fan等人,2023)。

blocks.en:
In the image-text domain, ShareGPT4V ( Chen et al., 2024a ) trains a captioning model on a curated set of image-caption pairs and uses it to generate large-scale detailed descriptions. SynthCLIP ( Hammoud et al., 2024 ) creates synthetic image-text pairs with text-to-image generation while LaCLIP ( Fan et al., 2023 ) rewrites existing captions as a form of textual augmentation. DreamLIP ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) further demonstrates that recaptioning images with off-the-shelf MLLMs can significantly improve downstream performance by generating richer textual supervision.
For the video domain, ShareGPT4Video ( Chen et al., 2024b ) extends large-scale recaptioning to videos by first collecting and annotating approximately 40K high-quality video-caption pairs, which are then used to train a video captioner for generating 4.8M detailed video-text pairs. InternVid ( Wang et al., 2024b ) constructs video annotations by generating frame-level captions using BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023a ) and subsequently summarizing them into short video-level descriptions with an LLM. Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024c ) further scales supervision generation by employing eight different MLLMs to generate caption candidates. However, a set of generated captions is verified and selected by human annotators before training an automatic caption-selection model for final data generation.
Our framework is fully automated and generates multiple detailed and complementary textual views, providing richer supervision than short single-caption supervision.
blocks.zh:
在图像文本领域,ShareGPT4V(Chen et al., 2024a)在一组被曲解的图像封装配对上培训一个字幕模型,并利用它生成大规模的详细描述. 合成CLIP (Hammoud等人,2024年) 以文本到图像生成创建合成图像-文本对,而LaCLIP(Fan等人,2023年)则将现有标题重写为文本增强的一种形式. DreamLIP(Zheng等人,2024年)进一步证明,用现成的MLLMs重现图像可以通过产生更丰富的文字监督来显著改善下游的性能.
视频域名 ShareGPT4Video (Chen et al., 2024b)通过首先收集并注释大约40K高品质的视频封装对子,将大规模复刻扩展至视频,然后用于培训生成4.8M详细视频文本对子的视频字幕. 实习生 Vid(Wang et al., 2024b)通过使用BLIP-2(Li et al., 2023a)生成帧级字幕来构建视频说明,随后将其归纳为带有LLM的短视频级描述. 熊猫-70M(Chen等人,2024c)通过使用8种不同的MLLM来生成字幕候选人,进一步扩展了监管生成. 然而,在培训用于最终数据生成的自动字幕选择模型之前,由人类注释员核实和选择一组生成的字幕。
我们的框架是完全自动化的,产生多种详细和互补的文字观点,提供比简短的单一标题监督更丰富的监督。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 MLLM-Based Multi-View Supervision Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 基于MLLM的多视频监督生成

blocks.en: Large-scale video-text pretraining critically depends on the quality of video-text supervision. Existing web-scale datasets typically associate each video with a single caption, which often captures only a limited aspect of the visual content and overlooks rich spatiotemporal semantics. While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate more informative descriptions, they may introduce hallucinations and unsupported details. We therefore design our supervision generation framework around three complementary objectives: semantic diversity, visual fidelity, and semantic coverage. Specifically, we generate multiple complementary captions, refine them through visual verification, and create additional semantic positive captions that capture different aspects of the same video. Together, these stages produce a supervision corpus that is diverse, visually faithful, and semantically comprehensive.
blocks.zh: 大规模视频文本预训的关键取决于视频文本监督的质量. 现有的网络尺度数据集通常将每个视频都与单一标题联系起来,通常只捕捉视觉内容的有限方面,忽略了丰富的spatiotemal语义. 虽然最近的多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)可以产生更多的信息描述,但它们可能会引入幻觉和不支持的细节. 因此,我们围绕三个相辅相成的目标设计我们的监督生成框架:语义多样性、视觉忠诚和语义覆盖。 具体来说,我们生成多个互补的字幕,通过视觉验证加以精炼,并创建额外语义正字幕,捕捉同一视频的不同方面. 这些阶段共同产生了一个多样化、视觉上忠实和全面的监督机构。

blocks.en: Starting from InternVid-10M-FLT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , we construct a large-scale multi-view supervision corpus through three stages: (i) multi-view caption generation, (ii) reasoning-based caption refinement, and (iii) semantic positive caption generation. Given an input collection of videos 𝒱 = { v i } i = 1 N \mathcal{V}=\{v_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} with N ≈ 10 7 N\approx 10^{7} , our goal is to generate multiple semantically complementary supervision signals for each video, as illustrated in Figure 1 . We denote summary captions by S S , detailed captions by D D , refined detailed captions by D ∗ D^{*} , and semantic positive captions by P P . Each stage increases either the diversity, fidelity, or semantic coverage of the supervision.

blocks.zh: 3.1.1 多维字幕生成。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Reasoning-Based Caption Refinement.
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 基于理由的说明

blocks.en: Detailed captions provide richer supervision but frequently contain unsupported actions and artifacts such as subtitles, text overlays, user-interface elements, or incorrect information. We therefore introduce a reasoning-capable refinement stage that treats generated captions as noisy supervision candidates. Rather than generating a new description from scratch, the model acts as a verifier checking consistency between textual and visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 详细标题提供了更丰富的监督,但经常包含不支持的行动和文物,如字幕,文本覆盖,用户界面元素,或不正确的信息. 因此,我们引入了能够推理的完善阶段,将生成的字幕视为吵闹的监督候选人。 该模型不是从零开始产生新的描述,而是起到核查者的作用,检查文字证据和视觉证据的一致性。

blocks.en:
Given a detailed caption D m D_{m} for m ∈ { 1 , 2 } m\in\{1,2\} , we employ a reasoning-capable MLLM g g based on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) : D m ∗ = g ⁡ ( v i , D m ) , D_{m}^{*}=g(v_{i},D_{m}), (2) where the model jointly receives both the original video and the generated caption as input. We prompt the MLLM to preserve visually grounded content while removing unsupported details, potentially hallucinated actions, subtitles, watermarks, and non-visual inferences such as speech, intentions, or emotions. This stage, therefore, improves supervision fidelity while maintaining semantic richness.
Although refinement substantially reduces incorrect information, some residual inaccuracies may still remain due to limitations of the underlying MLLM.
For each video v i v_{i} , this stage generates two refined detailed captions D 1 ∗ D_{1}^{*} and D 2 ∗ D_{2}^{*} from D 1 D_{1} and D 2 D_{2} , respectively.
3.1.3 Semantic Positive Caption Generation.
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 语义正标题生成.

blocks.en: Although refined detailed captions provide stronger visual grounding, a single description still captures only one semantic interpretation of a complex video. Multiple valid descriptions may exist depending on the event, interaction, object, or temporal phase being emphasized. We therefore generate additional semantic positive captions that shift the semantic focus while preserving visual correctness.
blocks.zh: 虽然精细的详细字幕提供了更强的视觉地面,但单一的描述仍然只捕捉到一个复杂视频的一个语义解释. 根据强调的事件、互动、对象或时间阶段,可能存在多种有效的描述。 因此,我们生成更多的语义正标题,在保持视觉正确性的同时转移语义焦点.

blocks.en: Unlike conventional paraphrasing, which primarily changes the language of the same description, semantic positive captions intentionally describe different yet visually grounded aspects of the same video. One may emphasize the manipulated object, another the interaction, and another the resulting state, while all remain semantically consistent with the underlying visual content. We randomly select one refined detailed caption D m ∗ D_{m}^{*} , where m ∈ { 1 , 2 } m\in\{1,2\} , and generate two semantic positive captions in one call: ( P 1 , P 2 ) = h ⁡ ( v i , D m ∗ ) , (P_{1},P_{2})=h(v_{i},D_{m}^{*}), (3) where h h denotes Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , conditioned jointly on the video and the selected refined detailed caption. Each semantic positive caption explicitly describes the actor, action, interacting object, and resulting outcome while emphasizing a different grounded aspect whenever possible.

blocks.en: 3.2 Video-Text Pretraining
blocks.zh: 3.2 视频文本

blocks.en: We adopt a two-stage video-text pretraining framework following recent video-text models ( Li et al., 2023b ) , while modifying the training pipeline to use the proposed multi-view supervision corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一个采用近期视频文本模型(Li等人,2023年b)的两阶段视频文本预训框架,同时修改培训管道,以使用拟议的多视图监督令。

blocks.en: We initialize the visual encoder using SMILE ( Thoker et al., 2025 ) , a masked video representation learning framework that jointly captures spatial semantics and motion dynamics through masked reconstruction objectives. Compared with conventional masked video pretraining, SMILE provides stronger motion-aware representations, which are particularly beneficial for downstream video-text alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们使用SMILE(Thoker等人,2025年)初始化视觉编码器,这是一个蒙面视频表现学习框架,通过蒙面重建目标共同捕捉空间语义和运动动力学. 与传统的蒙面视频预训相比,SMILE提供了更强的动作感知表现,这尤其有利于下游视频文本的对齐.

blocks.en:
Starting from the pretrained visual encoder, we perform video-text pretraining using the supervision set 𝒞 ⁡ ( v i ) \mathcal{C}(v_{i}) . We use two CLS tokens in the text encoder: one for summary captions (including O O ) and one for refined detailed and semantic positive captions. During pretraining, we randomly sample for each video v i v_{i} one caption for each CLS token: c s ∼ { S 1 , S 2 , O } , c d ∼ { D 1 ∗ , D 2 ∗ , P 1 , P 2 } . c_{s}\sim\left\{S_{1},S_{2},O\right\},\quad c_{d}\sim\left\{D_{1}^{*},D_{2}^{*},P_{1},P_{2}\right\}. (5) We encode the two captions separately, using the matching CLS token for each, and share the video representation between them. We train with three standard video-text objectives: video-text contrastive learning (VTC), video-text matching (VTM), and masked language modeling (MLM). For VTC and VTM, each caption is paired with the video using its corresponding CLS representation, and we apply MLM to both captions. For the summary view, the combined loss is ℒ s = ℒ VTC s + ℒ VTM s + ℒ MLM s . \mathcal{L}^{s}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VTC}}^{s}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VTM}}^{s}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MLM}}^{s}. (6) The detailed-view loss ℒ d \mathcal{L}^{d} is computed in the same way, using
the sampled refined detailed or semantic positive caption and its corresponding CLS token. We average the
summary-view and detailed-view losses to obtain the overall objective: ℒ = 1 2 ​ ( ℒ s + ℒ d ) . \mathcal{L}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathcal{L}^{s}+\mathcal{L}^{d}\right). (7) During zero-shot text-to-video retrieval, we encode each text query twice, once with the summary CLS token and once with the detailed CLS token. We compute each text representation’s similarity to every candidate video and average the two similarity scores for each text-video pair. We then rank the videos by the averaged scores, following the UMT evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: Compared with conventional video-text pretraining pipelines that rely on a single caption per video, our framework exposes the model to multiple semantically consistent yet complementary textual views, enabling stronger alignment between visual content and language semantics.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
For Stage I, we use publicly available SMILE ( Thoker et al., 2025 ) checkpoints with ViT-B and ViT-L backbones pretrained on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-700 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) , respectively. For Stage II, we initialize the video encoder from Stage I and use pretrained BERT-base/BERT-large as the text encoder following ( Li et al., 2023b ) . We pretrain on 5M or 10M videos from InternVid-10M-FLT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , as indicated in each results table, using the supervision set 𝒞 ⁡ ( v i ) \mathcal{C}(v_{i}) defined in Section 3 .
Each video is represented using 16 randomly sampled frames of resolution 224 × 224 224\times 224 with a video token masking ratio of 10 % 10\% , while captions are truncated to 128 tokens. Training is conducted on 16 GPUs with batch size 128 per GPU for 20 epochs using AdamW ( l ​ r = 10 − 4 lr=10^{-4} , weight decay 0.02 0.02 ). We adopt cosine decay with one warmup epoch and a final learning rate of 1 % 1\% of the initial value. The pretraining objective combines VTC, VTM, and MLM with equal weights, where VTM employs hard negative mining, VTC uses a temperature of 0.07 0.07 , and MLM applies a token masking ratio of 0.5 0.5 .
During pretraining, we sample one summary caption from { O , S 1 , S 2 } \{O,S_{1},S_{2}\} and one refined detailed or semantic positive caption from { D 1 ∗ , D 2 ∗ , P 1 , P 2 } \{D_{1}^{*},D_{2}^{*},P_{1},P_{2}\} , and encode them using their corresponding summary-view and detailed-view CLS tokens. Unless otherwise specified, all main results use this dual- CLS configuration.

blocks.en: 4.1 Standard Text-to-Video Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.1 标准文本对视频检索

blocks.en:
We evaluate on five standard video-text retrieval benchmarks: MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) , DiDeMo ( Hendricks et al., 2017 ) , ActivityNet ( Caba Heilbron et al., 2015 ) , LSMDC ( Rohrbach et al., 2015 ) , and MSVD ( Chen & Dolan, 2011 ) , following prior works.
MSR-VTT and MSVD focus on general semantic alignment over open-domain videos with diverse activities and scenes. DiDeMo and ActivityNet place greater emphasis on temporal reasoning and activity understanding, requiring the model to capture dynamically evolving content and long-range temporal dependencies. LSMDC presents a more challenging movie-based setting with complex narratives and richer contextual semantics. We strictly follow ( Li et al., 2023b ) for both zero-shot and fine-tuning evaluation. We report text-to-video retrieval performance using Recall (R@1).
blocks.zh:
我们评价了五个标准视频文本检索基准:MSR-VTT(徐等人,2016年),DiDeMo(Hendricks等人,2017年),ActiveNet(Caba Heilbron等人,2015年),LSMDC(Rohrbach等人,2015年),以及MSVD(Chen & Dolan,2011年),之后的作品.
MSR-VTT和MSVD侧重于一般语义上与具有多种活动和场景的开放域视频对齐. DiDeMo 和活动 净值更加重视时间推理和活动理解,要求模型捕捉动态变化的内容和长距离的时间依赖性. LSMDC提供了一个更具挑战性的基于电影的设定,包含复杂的叙事和丰富的背景语义. 我们严格遵循(Li等人,2023年b),进行零射和微调评价。 我们使用Recall(R@1)报告文本到视频的检索性能。

blocks.en: Table 1 presents zero-shot text-to-video retrieval results across five benchmarks. Under the 5M setting, our model outperforms prior approaches trained with comparable amounts of data. Compared with UMT-B, MVC-B improves by +8.6 on MSR-VTT, +25.5 on DiDeMo, and +30.3 on ActivityNet, while MVC-L similarly surpasses UMT-L by +27.2 on DiDeMo and +32.0 on ActivityNet. Compared with UMT pretrained on Panda-5M using captions generated by multiple cross-modality teachers, our approach achieves substantially stronger performance on MSR-VTT, DiDeMo, and MSVD using the same pretraining scale. These results suggest that richer supervision quality is more effective for learning video-text representations.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了五个基准的零镜头文本到视频检索结果。 在5M的设定下,我们的模型的效绩超过了以往以可比数量数据培训的方法。 与UMT-B相比,MVC-B在MSR-VTT上改进了+8.6,在DiDeMo上改进了+25.5,在ActiveNet上改进了+30.3,而MVC-L在DiDeMo上也以+27.2和在ActiveNet上改进了UMT-L. 与使用多个跨模式教师生成的字幕在熊猫-5M上预训的UMT相比,我们的方法在MSR-VTT,DiDeMo和MSVD上使用相同的预训规模实现了显著的更强的性能. 这些结果表明,更丰富的监督质量对学习视频文本表述更为有效。

blocks.en: More importantly, Baseline-B provides a controlled comparison that isolates the effect of our proposed supervision. Baseline-B uses the same backbone (with single- CLS ), training framework, and 5M InternVid videos as MVC-B, but is trained with only the original captions O O . Replacing the original supervision with MVC improves R@1 from 34.2 to 38.2 on MSR-VTT, 32.7 to 58.9 on DiDeMo, 29.6 to 58.6 on ActivityNet, 11.1 to 18.1 on LSMDC, and 39.1 to 43.3 on MSVD. The largest gains occur on DiDeMo (+26.2) and ActivityNet (+29.0), where retrieval requires matching videos to comparatively detailed descriptions of events and activities. This controlled comparison shows that the improvements arise substantially from enriching the textual supervision, rather than simply increasing the number of pretraining videos.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,基线-B提供了一种可控的比较,隔离了我们拟议监督的影响。 B基线-B使用与MVC-B相同的主干(带有单-CLS),培训框架,以及5M InternVid视频,但只使用原字幕O . 以MVC取代最初的监管方式在MSR-VTT上将R@1从34.2提高到38.2,在DieMo上将32.7提高到58.9,在ActiveNet上将29.6提高到58.6,在LSMDC上将11.1提高到18.1,在MSVD上将39.1提高到43.3. 最大的收益来自DiDeMo(+26.2)和活动网(+29.0),其检索需要将视频与事件和活动比较详细的描述相匹配。 这种有控制的比较表明,改进在很大程度上来自丰富文字监督,而不是仅仅增加预训录像的数量。

blocks.en: We further compare with methods pretrained on substantially larger corpora, ranging from 17M to 646M samples. Despite using only 10M videos, MVC-L remains competitive across standard retrieval benchmarks and achieves particularly strong performance on DiDeMo and ActivityNet. Compared with UMT-L pretrained on 17M videos, MVC-L improves R@1 by 15.6 points on DiDeMo and 24.1 points on ActivityNet while using fewer pretraining videos. Notably, MVC-L reaches 62.0 R@1 on DiDeMo and 66.9 on ActivityNet, compared with 31.5 and 30.7 for InternVideo trained on 646M samples. Together with the controlled Baseline-B comparison, these results suggest that richer multi-view supervision can achieve strong performance with substantially fewer pretraining videos.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步比较了在大得多的蝎子上预先训练的方法,从17M到646M样本不等. 尽管只使用了10M视频,MVC-L仍然具有跨标准检索基准的竞争力,在DiDeMo和ActiveNet上取得了特别强的业绩. 与17M视频上的UMT-L预训相比,MVC-L在DiDeMo上改进了R@1的15.6分,在ActiveNet上改进了24.1分,同时使用预训视频较少. 值得注意的是,MVC-L在DiDeMo上达到62.0R@1,在ActiveNet上达到66.9,而在实习视频中则有31.5和30.7对646M样本进行了培训。 这些结果与受控的基线-B比较一起表明,更丰富的多视图监督能够通过大量减少预训视频而实现强效.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports text-to-video retrieval after end-to-end fine-tuning. The improvements observed under zero-shot evaluation largely persist after task-specific adaptation. At the 5M scale, MVC-L substantially outperforms UMT-L on DiDeMo (+21.6), ActivityNet (+14.0), and LSMDC (+5.5), while also improving MSR-VTT (+2.2).
blocks.zh: 表2报告端到端微调后文本到视频检索情况. 在零镜头评价中观察到的改进在针对具体任务的调整之后基本上继续存在。 在5M尺度上,MVC-L在DiDeMo(+21.6),活动网(+14.0)和LSMDC(+5.5)上的MVC-L的性能大大超过UMT-L,同时也改进了MSR-VTT(+2.2).

blocks.en: The controlled comparison with Baseline-B further shows that the benefits of our supervision persist after fine-tuning. With the same architecture and pretraining videos, MVC-B improves R@1 from 48.0 to 50.3 on MSR-VTT, 61.2 to 72.9 on DiDeMo, 55.7 to 64.4 on ActivityNet, 31.1 to 34.1 on LSMDC, and 45.0 to 46.0 on MSVD. Thus, the richer representations learned from multi-view supervision remain beneficial even after adaptation to individual downstream datasets.
blocks.zh: 与基线-B的控制比较进一步表明,经过微调后,我们监督的好处依然存在。 MVC-B使用相同的架构和预训视频,在MSR-VTT上将R@1从48.0改进为50.3,在DiDeMo上将61.2改进为72.9,在ActiveNet上将55.7改进为64.4,在LSMDC上将31.1改进为34.1,在MSVD上将45.0改进为46.0. 因此,从多观点监督中汲取的丰富表述即使在适应了单个下游数据集之后仍然有益。

blocks.en: The advantage also extends to the 10M setup. MVC-L achieves 58.1, 82.9, 75.2, and 45.6 R@1 on MSR-VTT, DiDeMo, ActivityNet, and LSMDC, respectively, outperforming UMT-L pretrained on 17M videos by 1.6, 16.3, 8.6, and 4.2 points. Similarly, compared with ViCLIP-L, which also incorporates InternVid-10M-FLT in its substantially larger pretraining corpus, MVC-L improves DiDeMo from 49.4 to 82.9 (+33.5) and ActivityNet from 49.8 to 75.2 (+25.4). These results further highlight the data efficiency of our approach, with particularly strong gains on benchmarks requiring retrieval from richer event and activity descriptions.
blocks.zh: 优势也扩展到10M设置. MVC-L在MSR-VTT,DiDeMo,ActiveNet和LSMDC上分别实现58.1,82.9,75.2和45.6R@1,在17M视频上预训成绩优于UMT-L,分别达到1.6,16.3,8.6和4.2分. 同样,与ViCLIP-L(还将InternVid-10M-FLT纳入其规模大得多的预训书)相比,MVC-L将DiDeMo从49.4改进为82.9(+33.5),活动网从49.8改进为75.2(+25.4)。 这些结果进一步突出了我们方法的数据效率,在需要从更丰富的事件和活动说明中检索的基准方面特别大的进展。

blocks.en: 4.2 Fine-Grained and Detailed Text-to-Video Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.2 精细和详细文本检索

blocks.en: Standard text-to-video retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate alignment with summary-level descriptions, which may not adequately assess fine-grained visual understanding, temporal reasoning, or long-form semantics. Since our framework explicitly improves supervision quality through detailed, faithful, and diverse captions, we additionally evaluate zero-shot retrieval on CaReBench ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , DREAM-1K ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and Shot2Story20K ( Han et al., 2023 ) , which require richer text-to-video alignment. CaReBench evaluates spatial and temporal understanding through separate spatial and temporal retrieval settings. DREAM-1K focuses on fine-grained actions and event progressions, where we evaluate both detailed-description and event-based retrieval. Shot2Story20K consists of videos with multiple shots. We evaluate whole-clip retrieval and single-shot retrieval to assess long-form narrative semantics and local event understanding. We report text-to-video retrieval using Recall (R@1).
blocks.zh: 标准文本到视频检索基准主要评价与摘要级描述的吻合,这些描述可能无法充分评估精细的视觉理解,时间推理,或长式语义. 由于我们的框架通过详细、忠实和多样的字幕明确提高了监督质量,我们进一步评估了Care Bench(徐等人,2025年),DREAM-1K(王等人,2024年a)和Shot2Story20K(韩等人,2023年)的零镜头检索,这需要更丰富的文本与视频对齐。 Care Bench通过单独的空间和时间检索设置来评价空间和时间的理解. DREAM-1K专注于精细的动作和事件进展,我们在这里评价详细描述和基于事件的检索. Shot2Story20K由多镜头的视频组成. 我们评价全clip检索和单镜头检索,以评估长式叙事语义和本地事件理解. 我们使用Recall(R@1)报告文本到视频检索。

blocks.en: Table 3 presents zero-shot retrieval results on fine-grained and detailed benchmarks. The direct comparison between Baseline-B and MVC-B reveals particularly large gains in these more challenging retrieval settings. Using the same 5M videos, MVC improves R@1 by 38.2 points on CARE-S, 30.5 on CARE-T, 34.6 on DREAM-D, 10.6 on DREAM-E, 32.0 on S2S-W, and 29.1 on S2S-S. The consistent improvements across spatial, temporal, detailed-description, event-level, and multi-shot retrieval demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for learning richer video-text correspondences. We separately isolate the contributions of multi-view supervision and granularity-aware text representations in Section 4.3 .

blocks.en: The gains remain substantial compared with models trained on considerably more data. MVC-B pretrained on a 5M video subset outperforms UMT-L pretrained on 25M videos across all six settings, by 7.9 points on CARE-S, 13.0 on CARE-T, 11.0 on DREAM-D, 2.4 on DREAM-E, 18.8 on S2S-W, and 8.4 on S2S-S, despite using a smaller backbone and fewer videos. Scaling to MVC-L at the same 5M video scale further increases these margins to 9.4, 19.7, 12.6, 6.4, 20.4, and 11.3 points, respectively. These results show that the benefits of our framework become particularly pronounced when retrieval requires finer-grained or more descriptive video-text alignment.
blocks.zh: 与接受更多数据培训的模型相比,这些成果仍然很大。 MVC-B在5M视频子集的预训上超越了所有6个设置的25M视频的UMT-L预训,在CARE-S,13.0在CARE-T,11.0在DREAM-D,2.4在DREAM-E,18.8在S2S-W,8.4在S2S-S,尽管使用了更小的骨干和更少的视频. 在同样的5M视频尺度上,将MVC-L的比值进一步提高到9.4、19.7、12.6、6.4、20.4和11.3分。 这些结果表明,当检索需要精细或描述性更强的视频文本时,我们框架的好处就变得特别明显。

blocks.en: This trend also holds against models pretrained on substantially larger corpora. Compared with ViCLIP-L, which additionally leverages CLIP-400M pretraining, MVC-L trained on 10M videos improves R@1 by 37.2 points on CARE-S, 32.9 on CARE-T, 40.9 on DREAM-D, 10.3 on DREAM-E, 41.3 on S2S-W, and 33.7 on S2S-S. MVC-L also consistently outperforms Long-CLIP-L across all six settings despite Long-CLIP’s specialized long-text modeling. Together, these results support the complementary contributions of caption granularity, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive captions to the effectiveness of our supervision pipeline.
blocks.zh: 这一趋势也不利于对大公司进行预先训练的模型。 与另外利用CLIP-400M预训的ViCLIP-L相比,接受10M视频培训的MVC-L在CARE-S上提高了37.2分,在CARE-T上提高了32.9分,在DREAM-D上提高了40.9分,在DREAM-E上提高了10.3分,在S2S-S上提高了33.7分,尽管CLIP专业的长文模型化,MVC-L在所有六个场合都一直优于长文IP-L。 这些结果共同支持了标题颗粒性、基于推理的完善和语义上的正面标题对我们监督管道的有效性的补充性贡献。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: For computational efficiency, we conduct all ablations on a 1M-video subset of our pretraining corpus, use a video masking ratio of 50%, while keeping the rest of the architecture, optimization, and training schedule fixed unless otherwise specified. We report zero-shot text-to-video R@1 on MSVD, ActivityNet, DiDeMo, LSMDC, CARE-T, and Shot2Story-S. The supervision ablations in Tables 4 and 5 use a standard single- CLS representation, while Table 6 separately evaluates our dual- CLS design under identical supervision.

blocks.en: Table 4 studies the effect of progressively enriching the textual supervision. Replacing the original captions ( O O ) with our summary captions ( S S ) improves performance across all six benchmarks, with particularly large gains on ActivityNet (25.9 → \rightarrow 46.2), DiDeMo (29.3 → \rightarrow 46.0), CARE-T (27.1 → \rightarrow 48.0), and Shot2Story-S (42.2 → \rightarrow 63.2). This shows that summary captions generated from complementary MLLMs provide substantially more effective supervision than the original captions. Enriching these summary captions with refined detailed captions and semantic positive captions ( S + D ∗ + P S+D^{*}+P ) further improves all six benchmarks, reaching 50.1 on ActivityNet, 52.4 on DiDeMo, 54.1 on CARE-T, and 67.4 on Shot2Story-S. Finally, retaining the original caption alongside our generated supervision ( O + S + D ∗ + P O+S+D^{*}+P ) yields the best or equal-best performance across all benchmarks, including a notable improvement from 16.7 to 18.2 on LSMDC. These results suggest that the multi-view captions provide rich complementary supervision compared to the single-view captions across diverse downstream settings.

blocks.en: Table 5 isolates the contributions of caption complementarity, refinement, and semantic positive captions. Detailed captions alone ( D D ) perform worse than summary captions ( S S ) across all benchmarks, indicating that detailed captions do not replace summary captions when used in isolation. Combining the two granularities ( S + D S+D ), however, improves over S S alone on five of the six benchmarks, including ActivityNet (46.2 → \rightarrow 48.5), DiDeMo (46.0 → \rightarrow 48.6), and CARE-T (48.0 → \rightarrow 50.1), demonstrating their complementary nature. Replacing the unrefined detailed captions with refined detailed captions ( S + D ∗ S+D^{*} ) improves performance consistently across all six benchmarks, supporting the benefit of reasoning-based refinement. Adding semantic positive captions further improves every benchmark, with particularly clear gains on DiDeMo (49.7 → \rightarrow 52.4) and CARE-T (51.8 → \rightarrow 54.1). Together, these results validate the three objectives of our supervision pipeline: complementary caption granularities provide diverse semantic views, refinement improves visual fidelity, and semantic positive captions expand the semantic coverage of the supervision.

blocks.en: Finally, Table 6 evaluates whether summary captions and refined detailed or semantic positive captions benefit from separate text representations. Both variants use identical O + S + D ∗ + P O+S+D^{*}+P supervision, isolating the effect of the representation design. The dual- CLS model consistently outperforms the standard single- CLS representation across all six benchmarks, improving ActivityNet from 50.1 to 51.3, DiDeMo from 53.0 to 54.3, and CARE-T from 54.1 to 56.4, with the largest gain of 2.3 points on CARE-T. These results show that explicitly modeling the summary and detailed views with separate representations provides an additional benefit beyond multi-view supervision alone, motivating the dual- CLS design used in our final model.
blocks.zh: 最后,表6评价摘要标题和精细的文字正文标题是否受益于单独的文字说明。 两个变体都使用相同的O + S + D * + P+S+D++P监督,隔离表示设计的效果. 双层CLS模式一贯超过标准单层CLS代表,覆盖所有六个基准,将ActiveNet从50.1提高到51.3, DiDeMo从53.0提高到54.3,CARE-T从54.1提高到56.4,在CARE-T上收益最大,为2.3分. 这些结果表明,用单独的表述方式明确模拟摘要和详细观点,不仅能促进多视角监督,还有利于推动我们最后模型中使用的双重CLS设计。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We revisit video-text pretraining from the perspective of supervision quality and propose a large-scale MLLM-based multi-view supervision framework for generating richer video-text annotations. By combining multi-view caption generation, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive generation, our approach improves supervision diversity, visual fidelity, and semantic coverage beyond conventional single-caption annotations.
We further introduce a granularity-aware text representation that separately models short and detailed descriptions,
enabling the model to better exploit their complementary supervision. Extensive experiments across standard, fine-grained, and detailed video retrieval benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, often surpassing approaches trained with larger datasets.
Our results highlight the supervision quality and granularity as important dimensions of scalable video-text learning, demonstrating that richer textual supervision can significantly improve the data efficiency of video-text pretraining.
blocks.zh:
我们从监督质量的角度重新审视视频文本预训,并提出一个基于MLLM的大规模多视图监督框架,以产生更丰富的视频文本说明。 通过结合多视图字幕生成,基于推理的精细化,以及语义上的正面生成,我们的方法提升了监督多样性,视觉忠诚度,语义覆盖度超越了常规的单标题说明.
我们还引入了颗粒感知文字表述法,将模型分为简短和详细描述,
使模型能够更好地利用它们的补充监督。 跨越标准、精细和详细视频检索基准的广泛实验表明,零镜头和精细调整的设置都取得了一致的成果,往往超过了经过更大数据集培训的方法。
我们的成果突出了监督质量和颗粒性是可扩展视频文本学习的重要方面,表明内容丰富的文本监督可以大大提高视频文本预训的数据效率.

blocks.en: For the 5M entries in Table 7 , MVC improves over the corresponding UMT models on ActivityNet-QA. MVC-B improves from 43.5 to 47.3 (+3.8), while MVC-L improves from 45.1 to 49.1 (+4.0). The gains on MSR-VTT-QA are more modest, with MVC-L improving from 45.5 to 46.0, while performance on MSVD-QA remains comparable (51.3 vs. 51.5). Increasing the number of video clips from 5M to 10M further improves all three benchmarks, with MVC-L reaching 50.0 on ActivityNet-QA, 46.3 on MSR-VTT-QA, and 51.9 on MSVD-QA. Notably, MVC-L achieves the strongest ActivityNet-QA result in the table despite using only 10M video clips, exceeding UMT-L trained on 17M reported pretraining videos (50.0 vs. 47.3) and models trained on substantially larger corpora. Overall, these results indicate that the benefits of our richer textual supervision extend beyond retrieval to downstream video-text understanding, with particularly strong improvements on ActivityNet-QA.
blocks.zh: 对于表7中的5M条目,MVC比活动网-QA上相应的UMT模型有所改进. MVC-B从43.5提高到47.3(+3.8),而MVC-L则从45.1提高到49.1(+4.0). MSR-VTT-QA的收益比较小,MVC-L从45.5提高到46.0,而MSVD-QA的性能仍然相当(51.3对51.5). 视频剪辑量从5M增加到10M进一步改善了所有三项基准,MVC-L在ActiveNet-QA上达到50.0,在MSR-VTT-QA上达到46.3,在MSVD-QA上达到51.9. 值得注意的是,MVC-L取得了最强的活动网-QA的结果,尽管只使用了10M的视频剪辑,超过UMT-L的培训,培训内容是17M报告的培训前录像(50.0对47.3)和对大公司培训的模型。 总的来说,这些结果表明,我们更丰富的文字监督的好处从检索延伸到下游的视频文本理解,对活动网-QA的改进尤为显著。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Video frames. Example of sub-sampled frames fed to the MLLMs for caption generation.
blocks.zh: 图2:视频帧. 提供给 MLLMs 用于字幕生成的子样本框架示例 。

blocks.en: A.2 MLLM-Based Multi-View Supervision Generation
blocks.zh: A.2 基于 MLLM 的多维监督生成

blocks.en: We detail the prompts used to generate the different captions hereafter. For all types of captions, the video frames and the corresponding textual prompt are jointly fed to the MLLM as input. We use separate prompts for summary captions, detailed captions, refined detailed captions, and semantic positive captions, matching the stages described in the Methodology section.
blocks.zh: 我们详细说明用于生成以下不同标题的提示。 对于所有类型的字幕,视频帧和相应的文字提示被联合输入MLLM作为输入. 我们对摘要标题、详细标题、精细详细标题和语义正标题使用单独的提示,与方法一节中描述的阶段相匹配。

blocks.en: Summary captions are intended to provide a short semantic anchor for each video. We therefore ask each captioning MLLM to describe only the dominant activity in a single concise sentence.
blocks.zh: 概要说明旨在为每部视频提供一个简短的语义主播. 因此,我们要求MLLM的每一个标题只用一个简明的句子来描述主导活动。

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct Describe the main activity in this video, summarize the result in a single sentence of maximum 16 words.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-30B-Instruct 描述本视频中的主要活动,总结结果为单句最多16字.

blocks.en: Tarsier2-Recap-7B Describe the main activity in this video in short.
blocks.zh: 塔西耶2号机(Cap-7B) 简略地描述这段视频中的主要活动.

blocks.en: Detailed captions aim to expose the pretraining model to richer visual evidence than summary captions. The prompt therefore encourages the MLLM to describe the visible content in detail while keeping the output bounded.
blocks.zh: 详细字幕旨在让预训模式接触到比摘要字幕更丰富的视觉证据. 因此,该提示鼓励MLLM详细描述可见内容,同时保持输出的界限.

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct Describe this video in detail, summarize the result in maximum of 128 words.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-30B-Instruct 详细描述这段视频,以最多128个单词概括结果.

blocks.en: Tarsier2-Recap-7B Describe the video in detail.
blocks.zh: 塔西耶2号机(Cap-7B) 详细描述影片。

blocks.en: Refined detailed captions are generated from each detailed caption independently. In each call, Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking receives the video and one draft detailed caption, either from Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct or Tarsier2-Recap-7B, and is asked to verify the caption against the visual content. The prompt emphasizes factual correction rather than free-form regeneration.
blocks.zh: 精细的详细标题由每个详细标题独立生成. 每次通话中,Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking都会收到视频和一份详细字幕草稿,无论是从Qune3-VL-30B-Instruct还是Tarsier2-Recap-7B获得,并被要求对照视觉内容验证字幕. 该示意图强调事实纠正,而不是自由形式的再生。

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking Analyze the visual content of this video focusing on the main action, objects, people, and environment. Be concrete and factual. Ignore text overlays, subtitles, watermarks, and UI elements. Do not infer audio, speech, emotions, or intentions. Look at the following caption which has been generated by a video captioning model. Identify and correct any inaccuracies or hallucinations. Remove text overlays, watermarks, and UI elements mentioned in the caption. Here is the caption: D m D_{m} . Write the new caption, based on the one already provided, but corrected to accurately reflect the visual content of the video only. Remove any foreign characters or symbols unrelated to the core video content.
blocks.zh: Quen3-VL-8B-思维 分析这段视频的视觉内容,重点是主要动作,物品,人和环境. 实事求是。 忽略文本覆盖,字幕,水印,以及UI元素. 不要推断音频、言论、情绪或意图。 以下字幕由视频字幕模型生成 。 找出并纠正任何不准确或幻觉。 删除标题中提及的文本覆盖、 水印和 UI 元素 。 以下是标题: Dm D_{m}. 根据已经提供的内容写出新的标题,但更正后只准确地反映视频的视觉内容。 删除任何与核心视频内容无关的外来字符或符号.

blocks.en: Semantic positive captions are generated from a refined detailed caption and the video. Unlike generic paraphrases, these captions are constrained to describe specific visible events that remain semantically consistent with the same video. We ask Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking to return two semantic positive captions by focusing on concrete actors, actions, objects, and outcomes. For each video, we randomly select one refined detailed caption D m ∗ D_{m}^{*} with m ∈ { 1 , 2 } m\in\{1,2\} and invoke the prompt once; the call returns P 1 P_{1} and P 2 P_{2} .
blocks.zh: 语义上的正标题来自精细的详细标题和视频. 与一般的诠释不同的是,这些标题被限制用来描述与同一视频保持同步的特定可见事件. 我们要求Qune3-VL-8B-思考通过关注具体的行为者、行动、对象和结果,返回两个语义上的正标题。 每个视频,我们随机选择一个精细的详细字幕 D m ∗ D_{m}^{*} 与 m∈ { 1, 2} m\in\{1,2\} 并引用一次;调用返回 P 1 P_{1}和 P 2 P_{2}。

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking Based on the visual content of the video and on the following detailed caption D m ∗ D_{m}^{*} , provide two positive captions. Each positive caption must describe one specific, meaningful event that is clearly visible in the video, not a generic scene summary. Each positive must explicitly include the actor, the key action, the object or person involved, and the visible outcome or state change. Make the two positives non-identical by focusing on different moments or phases of the event when possible, while remaining fully faithful to what is shown. Use precise paraphrasing and action-level wording, and avoid vague text such as “someone does something” or purely static descriptions. Do not mention timestamps or frame numbers in the positives.
blocks.zh: Quen3-VL-8B-思维 根据视频的视觉内容以及以下详细字幕D m * D_{m}^{*},提供两个正面字幕. 每个正标题必须描述一个在视频中清晰可见的具体,有意义的事件,而不是一个通用的场景摘要. 每个积极因素必须明确包括行为者、关键行动、所涉对象或个人以及可见的结果或状态变化。 使这两个正值不相同,在可能时侧重于事件的不同时刻或阶段,同时完全忠实于所显示的内容. 使用精确的诠释和动作一级的措辞,并避免诸如“某人有所作为”或纯粹静止的描述等模糊的文字。 在正数中不要提及时间戳或帧数 。

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the mean and standard deviation of caption length in words for each intermediate and supervision view. The generated detailed captions are the longest and also show the largest spread, refinement reduces both their average length and variability, and the semantic positive captions remain concise while adding event-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 表8报告每个中间视图和监督视图中标题长度的平均偏差和标准偏差。 生成的详细字幕是最长的,同时也显示最广,精细化既减少了平均长度,也减少了可变性,语义正标题在添加特定事件监督的同时保持简洁.

blocks.en: Table 8: Caption statistics. We report the average and standard deviation of caption length in words for each intermediate and supervision view.
blocks.zh: 表8:说明统计。 我们报告每个中间视图和监督视图中标题长度的平均和标准偏差。

blocks.en: These word-count differences reflect the roles of the caption types: summary captions provide concise anchors, detailed captions provide broader context, and semantic positive captions focus on specific visible events.
blocks.zh: 这些单词计数差异反映了标题类型的作用:摘要标题提供简洁主播,详细标题提供更广泛的上下文,语义正标题侧重于特定可见事件.

blocks.en: To complement the caption-length statistics, we analyze how refinement modifies detailed captions over a subset of 100,000 records. Given a detailed caption D m D_{m} and its refined version D m ∗ D_{m}^{*} , we compute the Jaccard similarity over their content-word sets: J content ​ ( D m , D m ∗ ) = | C ⁡ ( D m ) ∩ C ⁡ ( D m ∗ ) | | C ⁡ ( D m ) ∪ C ⁡ ( D m ∗ ) | , J_{\mathrm{content}}(D_{m},D_{m}^{*})=\frac{|C(D_{m})\cap C(D_{m}^{*})|}{|C(D_{m})\cup C(D_{m}^{*})|}, where C ⁡ ( ⋅ ) C(\cdot) denotes the set of content words. Higher values indicate greater lexical overlap. Since this metric ignores word order, frequency, and sentence structure, it measures lexical overlap rather than semantic correctness or claim preservation.

The average caption lengths observed on the audited subset are consistent with the aggregated statistics present in Table 8 . Refinement reduces Qwen captions from 96.0 to 60.6 words and Tarsier captions from 80.1 to 60.3 words. No target length is imposed during refinement. Instead, as specified in the refinement prompt above, the model is instructed to remove text overlays, subtitles, watermarks, user-interface elements, unrelated symbols, hallucinated content, and non-visual inferences. The frequent shortening is therefore consistent with the intended removal of irrelevant or unsupported information. Qwen refinement yields a mean content-word Jaccard similarity of 0.405, with 0.47% exact matches, whereas Tarsier refinement is more conservative, yielding a similarity of 0.564 and 2.58% exact matches.
blocks.zh: 在审计子集中观察到的平均标题长度与表8中的总体统计数据一致。 完善后将Quen标题从96.0字减少到60.6字,塔西耶标题从80.1字减少到60.3字. 在改进过程中没有规定目标长度。 相反,正如上面的完善提示所指明的那样,该模型被指示去掉文本的覆盖,字幕,水印,用户界面元素,无关符号,幻觉内容,以及非视觉推论. 因此,频繁缩短与打算删除无关或无佐证的信息相一致。 Quen的精细化产生平均内容词Jaccard相似度为0.405,精确匹配率为0.47%,而Tarsier的精细化更保守,精确匹配率为0.564和2.58%.

blocks.en: We further use Gemma-3-12B-IT as an independent text-only evaluator to assess the semantic relation between each detailed caption and its refined version. Gemma classifies 98.54% of Qwen and 98.72% of Tarsier transformations as semantically consistent or compatible, including omissions and changes in temporal focus. Specifically, 93.13% of Qwen and 87.99% of Tarsier refinements are classified as compatible with omissions, while only 0.79% and 0.90%, respectively, are classified as contradictory. These results indicate that refinement substantially compresses and rewrites the detailed captions while rarely introducing text-level semantic conflicts. Since Gemma observes only the captions, this analysis measures semantic consistency and transformation behavior rather than visual correctness.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步使用Gemma-3-12B-IT作为独立的文本唯一评价者,以评估每个详细标题与其精细版本之间的语义关系。 Gemma将98.54%的Quen和98.72%的Tarsier变换归为整体一致或兼容,包括时间焦点的忽略和变化. 具体来说,93.13%的Quen和87.99%的Tarsier改进被归类为与遗漏兼容,而分别只有0.79%和0.90%被归类为矛盾. 这些结果表明,完善后将大量压缩和重写详细标题,而很少引入文本层面的语义冲突。 由于Gemma只观察标题,本分析衡量语义一致性和转化行为,而不是视觉正确性.

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates how refinement corrects object misidentification and removes unsupported actions in detailed captions. The original dataset caption and the Qwen3-VL-30B-Instruct captions incorrectly identify the animal as a dog, whereas the video shows a wet brown cat being dried with a pink towel. The detailed captions further introduce actions that are not supported by the visual content, such as lifting the animal’s head or body. Refinement with Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking corrects the animal category and removes these unsupported details in the detailed captions while preserving the visible drying activity. Incorrect or unsupported content in the input captions is highlighted in red , while corrected or visually grounded content in the refined detailed captions is highlighted in green .
blocks.zh: 图3说明了完善如何纠正对象识别错误,并删除详细标题中的不支持动作. 最初的数据集标题和Qwen3-VL-30B-指令标题错误地将动物识别为狗,而视频显示一只湿褐色的猫被粉红色毛巾擦干. 详细标题还引入了视觉内容不支持的行为,例如抬起动物的头部或身体。 用Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking来完善动物类别,并在保留可见的干燥活动的同时删除详细标题中这些不支持的细节. 输入标题中的不正确或不支持的内容以红色标出,而经过修改的详细标题中的更正或视像内容则以绿色标出。

The person continues to dry the cat’s sides, then focuses on the tail area by moving the towel along the cat’s back and sides. The person lifts the towel to dry the cat’s tail.
blocks.zh: 细化的详细标题 精细的Quen 标题 : 穿着蓝白色条纹衬衫和绿色鞋子的人,在浴室里用蓝色的瓷砖用粉红色毛巾晒干一只湿褐色的猫. 人将毛巾摩擦在猫的身体和尾巴上,移动到猫的皮毛上. 猫站在地板上,而人则继续干燥. 视频以人还干猫结束. 精细的塔西耶标题 : 在瓷砖房里,一个人用粉红色毛巾晒干一只湿褐色的猫. 将毛巾移过猫的身体。 此人继续将猫的侧面干燥,然后通过沿猫的背部和侧面移动毛巾来聚焦尾部区域. 此人举起毛巾将猫尾擦干.

blocks.en: Semantic positive captions Positive 1: A person wearing a blue and white striped shirt rubs a pink towel against the head of a brown tabby cat, with the cat remaining stationary on the blue-tiled floor while the towel makes contact with the cat’s fur. Positive 2: The same person shifts the pink towel to the back of the brown tabby cat, rubbing the towel over the cat’s fur as the cat takes a step forward on the blue-tiled floor.

blocks.en: A.3 Datasets
blocks.zh: A.3 数据集

blocks.en: All datasets used in this work are publicly available and were used in accordance with their original licenses and terms of use. We will release the generated captions for the InternVid-10M-FLT dataset after acceptance.
blocks.zh: 这项工作中使用的所有数据集均可公开查阅,并按照原始许可证和使用条件使用。 接收后我们将发布InternVid-10M-FLT数据集生成的字幕.

blocks.en: InternVid ( Wang et al., 2024b ) is a large-scale video-text dataset designed for multimodal understanding and generation. It contains over 7M web videos spanning approximately 760K hours, resulting in 234M video clips paired with automatically generated textual descriptions. In this work, we use the publicly released InternVid-10M-FLT subset containing 10M filtered video clips with original captions for large-scale video-text pretraining. We refer to these clips as videos in the method and results sections.
blocks.zh: InternVid(Wang et al., 2024b)是一个大型的视频文本数据集,为多模式理解和生成而设计. 它包含超过7M网络视频,长达约760K小时,导致234M视频片段与自动生成的文字描述对齐. 在这部作品中,我们使用公开发行的InternVid-10M-FLT子集,包含10M过滤的视频片段,并带有大规模视频文本预训的原始字幕. 我们在方法和结果部分将这些片段称为录像。

blocks.en: MSR-VTT ( Xu et al., 2016 ) is a large-scale open-domain benchmark containing 10,000 web videos and approximately 200,000 captions covering diverse content such as sports, music, cooking, and daily activities. It is widely used for evaluating general video-text alignment. It contains around 7000 training and 1000 test samples.
blocks.zh: MSR-VTT(徐等,2016年)是一个大型开放域基准,包含10,000个网络视频和约20万个字幕,涵盖了体育,音乐,烹饪,日常活动等多种内容. 它被广泛用于评价一般的视频文本配对. 它包含约7000个培训和1000个测试样本.

blocks.en: DiDeMo ( Hendricks et al., 2017 ) consists of around 10,000 videos paired with multiple descriptions associated with temporally localized events. The benchmark primarily evaluates retrieval under temporal event understanding. It contains around 8496 training and 1034 test samples.
blocks.zh: DiDeMo(Hendricks等人,2017年)由约10,000个视频组成,与时间局部事件相关的多个描述对齐. 该基准主要根据对时间事件的理解来评价检索。 它包含大约8496个培训和1034个测试样本.

blocks.en: ActivityNet Captions ( Caba Heilbron et al., 2015 ) contains approximately 20,000 long videos with dense temporal annotations describing activities and events. The longer duration and multiple events per video make retrieval more challenging. It contains around 10K training and 5K test samples.
blocks.zh: ActivityNet Captions(Caba Heilbron等人,2015年)包含约20,000个长视频,并带有密集的时间说明,描述活动和事件. 较长的长度和每个视频的多个事件使得检索更具挑战性. 它包含约10K培训和5K测试样本.

blocks.en: LSMDC ( Rohrbach et al., 2015 ) contains around 118,000 movie clips paired with text derived from scripts and audio descriptions. The benchmark includes complex scenes and narrative content from movies.
blocks.zh: LSMDC(Rohrbach等人,2015年)包含约118,000个电影剪辑片段,配对内容为从脚本和音频描述中衍生出来的文字. 基准包括复杂的场景和电影中的叙事内容.

blocks.en: MSVD ( Chen & Dolan, 2011 ) contains roughly 2,000 short videos with around 80,000 human-written captions. Despite its smaller size, it remains a commonly used benchmark for video-text evaluation.
blocks.zh: MSVD(Chen & Dolan, 2011)包含约2000个短视频, 尽管规模较小,它仍然是视频文本评价的常用基准.

blocks.en: CaReBench ( Xu et al., 2025 ) is a fine-grained retrieval benchmark providing separate spatial and temporal annotations, enabling independent evaluation of appearance-focused and temporal retrieval. The benchmark contains 1,000 test samples.
blocks.zh: Care Bench(徐等人,2025年)是一个精细的检索基准,提供单独的时空说明,能够对外观重点和时间检索进行独立评价. 基准包含1000个测试样本.

blocks.en: DREAM-1K ( Wang et al., 2024a ) contains 1,000 test videos paired with detailed descriptions of actions and event sequences. We evaluate both detailed-description retrieval and event-based retrieval settings.
blocks.zh: DREAM-1K(Wang et al., 2024a)包含1000个测试视频配对,详细描述动作和事件序列. 我们评价详细的描述检索和基于事件的检索设置。

blocks.en: Shot2Story20K ( Han et al., 2023 ) focuses on multi-shot video understanding using shot-level captions and video-level summaries. We use the 2,000-sample test split and evaluate both whole-clip and single-shot retrieval settings.
blocks.zh: Shhot2Story20K(Han等人,2023年)注重多镜头视频理解,使用镜头级别字幕和视频级别摘要. 我们使用2000个样本的测试拆分, 并评估整个剪辑和单镜头的检索设置。

blocks.en: A.4 Additional Ablations
blocks.zh: A.4 额外规定

blocks.en: Table 9 studies the effect of the video masking ratio while keeping the caption supervision fixed. Reducing the masking ratio from 50% to 10% improves performance on MSVD (38.8 → \rightarrow 39.7), ActivityNet (50.1 → \rightarrow 52.5), DiDeMo (53.0 → \rightarrow 54.3), and CARE-T (54.1 → \rightarrow 55.9), while performance on Shot2Story-S remains similar. In contrast, LSMDC favors the higher masking ratio, decreasing from 18.2 to 15.7 at 10%. Overall, a lower masking ratio is beneficial on most benchmarks, suggesting that retaining more visual tokens is advantageous when learning from richer textual supervision.
blocks.zh: 表9研究了录像遮掩率的影响,同时将字幕监督固定下来。 将遮掩率从50%降低到10%,提高了MSVD(38.8 → \rightarrow 39.7),ActiveNet(50.1 → rightarrow 52.5), DiDeMo(53.0 → \rightarrow 54.3)和CARE-T(54.1 → \rightarrow 55.9)的性能,而Shot2 Story-S的性能依然相似。 相比之下,LSMDC则倾向于较高的遮掩率,从18.2%降至15.7%,即10%。 总的来说,较低的遮掩率对大多数基准都有好处,这表明,在从更丰富的文字监督中学习时,保留更多的视觉标志是有利的。

blocks.en: Table 10 evaluates different training durations. Performance improves through 20 epochs, with smaller gains from 15 to 20 epochs than at earlier intervals. This differs from many previous video-text pretraining settings that commonly adopt shorter schedules, indicating that richer multi-view supervision can continue providing useful learning signals over longer optimization periods.
blocks.zh: 表10评价了不同的培训期限。 性能通过20个纪元有所改进,从15个纪元到20个纪元的收益比较早的间隔时间要小. 这与之前许多通常采用较短时间表的视频文本预训设置不同,表明更丰富的多视图监督可以在更长的优化期内继续提供有用的学习信号.
